entities.summary: Philip Caputo is an American author and journalist. He is best known for A Rumor of War (1977), a best-selling memoir of his experiences during the Vietnam War. Caputo has written 19 books, including three memoirs, five books of general nonfiction, nine novels, and two books of short stories. His latest is a collection of short stories Wandering Souls: And Other Stories which was published in 2025 by Arcade Publishing.
